script: Three strict Japanese school rules that would probably be illegal in your country. First, your underwear is completely regulated. Many schools mandate that students can only wear plain white underwear, and yes, teachers will literally do visual checks. If you are caught wearing a different color, you could be forced to remove it. Next, absolutely no hair dye is allowed, but it goes even further. If you are born with naturally brown or curly hair, you have to submit a formal "Real Hair Certificate" with childhood photos just to prove it. Otherwise, they will force you to dye it pitch black. But the wildest part? There are zero janitors. Every single day, students are expected to scrub the hallways, clean the literal toilets, and serve lunch to their classmates. It is meant to teach respect and discipline, but if you hate doing chores at home, you wouldn't survive a single week here.
title: The Great Emu War
